notes.title: 24.12.23 Ver 1.2 Patch
notes.notes:
Synergy
New Synergy

A new synergy  has been added.

 provides additional ‘Efficiency’ in generating memory points, based on the number of gears that exceed the power limit.

(2) 10% for every over gear count
(3) 20% for every over gear count
(4) 40% for every over gear count

Effect Adjustments

The number of gears required for the  has increased.

Level 1: 2 gears (unchanged)
Level 2: Increased from 3 to 4 gears

The effects of  have also been changed.

Previously, the core gear’s power increased after completing a set number of rotations, and the rotation counts reset when the synergy was canceled by pulling out the gear.
But now, the rotation count will no longer reset, even if the synergy is canceled.
The maximum level of  has increased from 2 to 3.

(2) 5% per stack
(3) 10% per stack
(4) 15% per stack (new!)

The maximum level and effects of  have been adjusted.
(2) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 10%
(3) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 5%
(4) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 2% (new!)

The maximum level of  has increased from 2 to 3.

(2) Add + 0.5 production to each of  gears.
(3) In addition, add +0.5 production.
(4) In addition, add +1 production. (new!)

Augment
New Augments

A new Augment  has been added.
Effect: Increases memory generation of  gears by 1.

A new Augment  has been added.
Effect: The supply cycle becomes shorter, but Power decreases by 1.

Supply

The increment of supply gauge by recycling gears has been reduced.

Gear Level 1: 10 → 4
Gear Level 2: 20 → 6
Gear Level 3: 30 → 8
Gear Level 4: 40 → 10

Deck Button

The deck button becomes more visible during the  and  phases.

Text Events

Based on user feedback, all text events can now be skipped.
Text events will now be displayed in smaller pop-up windows.
Some of the wrong sentences have been corrected.

Tutorial Description Changes

Tutorial descriptions have been improved.

Updated the tutorial explanation videos.

Misc.

The descriptions of , , , and  have been clearer.
